title: Film Production Studio Technique
description: An in-depth exploration of what it means to produce a film project. Students will learn strategies to coordinate and plan a production, with emphasis on collaboration and coordination. From project design and budgets to time management and casting, this course introduces students to the creative capacity of producing a film. Students may not receive credit for both VIS 183 and FILM 182. Prerequisites: VIS 60 or VIS 71 and VIS 70N or VIS 72. Open to media and cinematic arts majors only.
